Hope you’re well. Quick intro — I’m Amy (Head of Partnerships at NovaRetail). We’ve built an edge-to-cloud retail analytics connector that ingests POS and footfall streams and exports embeddings for downstream search and insights. Several of our joint prospects have asked whether we can list on GCP Marketplace + pursue a co-sell pathway with Redwood as the inference partner.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood support a GCP Private Offer listing for a combined bundle (NovaRetail runtime + Redwood inference routing)?
- What evidence and metering mapping do you need from our side to justify co-sell eligibility?
- Who on your side can help with listing metadata, SKU mapping, and a joint demo?

I attached a short intake note to this thread with technical summary + PoC notes. Looking to get a 30-min intake call next week (Nov 22–24).

Thanks — Amy

Short answers and next steps from our side:
1) GCP Private Offer + co-sell: yes, we can support a joint bundle but we’ll need metering SKUs and a clear revenue split to surface it in the marketplace.
2) Evidence: marketplace listing requires an architecture diagram, security questionnaire (SOC2 summary or equivalent), 30-day trial offer SKU (optional), and metering mapping for usage-based charges.
3) Internal owners: I’ll lead the GTM intake and co-sell ask (I own the partner POC lane). Ben will own the technical integration for entitlements; Olga will coordinate marketplace evidence; Karthik can advise on pricing/contract language if we move to a private offer.

Can you send the following by EOD Monday if possible:
- A short SKU/metering proposal (samples in the attached template)
- Security questionnaire (or pointer to your SOC2 doc)
- Preferred demo dates/times next Tue–Thu (Nov 23–24)

Attaching our short metering template so you can drop in SKUs: metering-mapping-template.xlsx. I’ll book a 30-min slot once we have availability.

Quick technical checklist before the call — some items I want pre-filled to speed the listing flow: 

- Expected throughput (TPS and average tokens per request) and peak concurrency for joint demo. Helps us size the Dedicated pool for demos.
- KV cache and prefixing expectations (are you sending full image embeddings or pre-filtered vectors?).
- Authentication model: will NovaRetail route inference calls through a customer-managed proxy/VPC, or call Redwood’s Hosted API? (If VPC, we need private connectivity docs for the marketplace listing).
- Metering model: Do you intend to charge per-ingestion, per-embedding, or per-inference minute? We prefer per-embedding or per-token for clearer cost attribution.

Also — public marketplace listings require a ‘co-sell summary’ field of 75–150 words describing how Redwood and NovaRetail drive joint value. If you want, I can draft a version for you to review.

On the attachments: Amy sent an intake PDF, and I dropped an example metering template into the thread (metering-mapping-template.xlsx). Please also attach any security verification (SOC2 or penetration test) to speed up QA.

Ben Carter
Head of Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
